item.title: Xbox Is Sending Out Forza Horizon 6 Gift Packages Ahead Of Its 2026 Release
item.description: Only to influencers though. Next year will obviously mark the release of Forza Horizon 6, and it sounds like Xbox is gearing up to share more news on the title very soon, with multiple influencers receiving special gift packages over the past few days. These packages contain various goodies like a custom numberplate, "Greetings from Japan" postcard and a Forza Horizon 6 air freshener.
